title: ZX Bank Ltd. – Branch Network in Jaipur

nodes.title: North Jaipur Branches
nodes.summary: Five North Jaipur branches in Amba Bari (Sikar Road), Hanuman Nagar (KH Road), Khatipura, Jhotwara Industrial Area and Shastri Nagar, with IFSC codes ZXIN0001201 to ZXIN0001205.

nodes.title: South Jaipur Branches
nodes.summary: Five South Jaipur branches in Malviya Nagar, Jawahar Circle (Tonk Road), Pratap Nagar (Sanganer), Durgapura and Mansarovar, with IFSC codes ZXIN0001301 to ZXIN0001305.

nodes.title: East Jaipur Branches
nodes.summary: Five East Jaipur branches in Raja Park (Govind Marg), Transport Nagar, Surya Nagar (Agra Road), Jawahar Nagar and Adarsh Nagar, with IFSC codes ZXIN0001401 to ZXIN0001405.

nodes.title: West Jaipur Branches
nodes.summary: Five West Jaipur branches in Vaishali Nagar (Queens Road), Kanakpura (Sirsi Road), Shyam Nagar (Ajmer Road), Chitrakoot (Vaishali Extension) and Nirman Nagar (Brijalal Road), with IFSC codes ZXIN0001501 to ZXIN0001505.

nodes.title: Central Jaipur Branches
nodes.summary: Five Central Jaipur branches are in MI Road, Bapu Bazar, C-Scheme (Ashok Marg), Civil Lines and Sindhi Camp (Station Road), with IFSC codes ZXIN0001601 to ZXIN0001605.
